chunks: When they are cast into it, they will hear it roar and raging

key_terms.تَفُورُ: Boiling or bubbling over, describing the churning, intense heat and agitation of Hellfire.
key_terms.شَهِيقاً: A deep, roaring sound or sigh, often describing the noise of Hell or the breath of the damned.

ai.seo_question: What do the terms 'shahiq' and 'tafur' describe regarding Hellfire in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'shahiq' (deep roar) and 'tafur' (boiling) are interpreted not merely as physical sensations but as manifestations of the soul's internal agitation and the external reality of divine retribution. This verse, from Surah Al-Mulk, emphasizes the visceral terror of Hell, reinforcing the concept of 'Barzakh' where the punishment begins even before the final resurrection, serving as a warning for the heedless.
